raw.description:
Availity delivers revenue cycle and related business solutions for health care professionals who want to build healthy, thriving organizations. Availity has the powerful tools, actionable insights and expansive network reach that medical businesses need to get an edge in an industry constantly redefined by change.

At Availity, we're not just another Healthcare Technology company; we're pioneers reshaping the future of healthcare! With our headquarters in vibrant Jacksonville, FL, and an exciting office in Bangalore, India, along with an exceptional remote workforce across the United States, we're a global team united by a powerful mission.

We're on a mission to bring the focus back to what truly matters – patient care. As the leading healthcare engagement platform, we're the heartbeat of an industry that impacts millions. With over 2 million providers connected to health plans, and processing over 12 billion transactions annually, our influence is continually expanding.

Join our energetic, dynamic, and forward-thinking team where your ideas are celebrated, innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. We're transforming the healthcare landscape, solving communication challenges, and creating connections that empower the nation's premier healthcare ecosystem.

Reporting into the Vice President, Strategic Operations & Enterprise Transformation, the Director of Strategic Operations & Enterprise Transformation is a senior execution leader responsible for driving delivery of strategic initiatives and enterprise improvement efforts. The role partners with functional and senior leaders to translate defined priorities into executable plans, bring discipline to cross‑functional work, and improve visibility into progress, risks, and outcomes.

This role is hands‑on and delivery‑oriented focused on coordination, governance, and follow‑through across complex initiatives rather than setting enterprise strategy.

Sponsorship, in any form, is not available for this position.

Location: Remote, US

Why you want to work on this team:

  • This team is responsible for tackling Availity’s most complex, ambiguous, and high-impact challenges—enterprise-wide.
  • This team is designed to have the influence and credibility to get things done
  • There is real opportunity to shape how strategic operations and transformation work is done,

To be qualified for this position you:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent preferred.
  • 8–10 years of experience in strategic operations, enterprise initiatives, consulting, or program leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, cross‑functional initiatives.
  • Strong planning, problem‑solving, and communication skills.
  • Proven ability to influence without authority in a matrixed environment.
  • Experience in technology‑enabled, product‑driven, or scaling organizations.
  • Background supporting enterprise‑level initiatives, transformation programs, or portfolio execution.
  • Strong partnership experience with Product, Engineering, Finance, or Commercial teams.
  • Comfort operating in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments.

You will set yourself apart with:

  • Experienced in healthcare consulting with long-term engagement experience
  • Proven track record in managing and leading cross functional, enterprise-level transformation

You will be:

Strategic Initiative Execution

  • Executing and supporting delivery of defined enterprise priorities and transformation initiatives.
  • Translating strategic direction into detailed execution plans, milestones, and success metrics.
  • Coordinating dependencies and sequencing across Product, Technology, Finance, Commercial, and Operations teams.

Program & Portfolio Leadership

  • Leading cross‑functional programs such as enterprise change initiatives, product launch readiness, pricing or intake governance, and other priority efforts.
  • Keeping initiatives on track through active management of timelines, scope, risks, and dependencies.
  • Driving accountability through clear ownership, regular check‑ins, and structured updates.

Execution Governance & Rigor

  • Running initiative‑level or portfolio‑level governance forums, status reviews, and working sessions.
  • Implementing consistent intake, tracking, and escalation practices for assigned initiatives.
  • Identifying execution risks, delivery bottlenecks, and resource constraints; surface tradeoffs and recommendations to leadership.

Performance Tracking & Insights

  • Developing and maintaining execution metrics, dashboards, and status reporting.
  • Providing concise, executive‑ready summaries highlighting progress, risks, and required decisions.
  • Analyzing trends to inform prioritization, sequencing, and corrective actions.

Change Enablement & Stakeholder Partnership

  • Partnering closely with functional leaders and teams to ensure initiatives are well‑understood and adoptable.
  • Supporting change efforts through clear communication, coordination, and follow‑through.
  • Serving as a trusted execution partner for senior leaders driving cross‑functional work.

Team Leadership & Capability Development

  • Leading and developing a small team or program pod, as applicable.
  • Setting clear priorities, expectations, and success measures for direct reports.
  • Contributing to shared tools, templates, and playbooks that improve execution consistency.

Availity culture and benefits:

  • Availity is a certified “Great Place to Work”! Culture is important to us and there are many ways for you to make your mark here!
  • Availity is a culture of continuous learning. We have many resources and experts in our tech stack and in our industry that can help get you there too!
  • Don’t feel like wearing business attire? Cool, you can wear jeans – we are a casual place.
  • We offer a competitive salary, bonus structure, generous HSA company contribution, healthcare, vision, dental benefits and a 401k match program that you can take advantage of on day one!
  • We offer unlimited PTO for salaried associates + 9 paid holidays. Hourly associates start at 19 days of PTO and go up from there with all the same holiday benefits.
  • Interested in wellness? We allow our associates to reimburse up to $250/year for gym memberships, participation in racing events, weight management programs, etc.
  • Interested in furthering your education? We offer education reimbursement!
  • Availity offers Paid Parental Leave for both moms and dads, both birth parents and adoptive parents.
  • Want to work for an organization that gives back to the community? You’re at the right place! Availity partners with various organizations, both locally and nationally, to raise awareness, funds and morale as our staff members volunteer their time and funds to engage the organizations campaign.

Next steps:

After you apply, you will receive text/email messages thanking you for applying and then you will continue to receive more text/email messages alerting you as to where you are in the recruitment process.

Interview process:

  • Recruiter Video Interview
  • Video Interview with Hiring Manager
  • Video with Director, Program Management
  • Video Interview with Vice President, Product and Vice President, Go to Market

Video Camera Usage:

Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.

Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.

Disclaimers:

Availity is an equal opportunity employer and makes decisions in employment matters without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, national origin, religion, marital status, medical condition, disability, military service, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, or any other classification protected by federal, state, and local laws and ordinances.

Availity is a drug-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.

By joining the American Red Cross you will touch millions of lives every year and experience the greatness of the human spirit at its best. Are you ready to be part of the world's largest humanitarian network?

Join us—Where your Career is a Force for Good!

Job Description:

Senior Director, Government Relations

WHY CHOOSE US?
Joining the American Red Cross is like nothing else – it’s as much something you feel as something you do. You become a vital part of the world’s largest humanitarian network. Joining a team of welcoming individuals who are exceptional, yet unassuming. Diverse, yet uncompromising in unity. You grow your career within a movement that matters, where success is measured in people helped, communities made whole, and individuals equipped to never stop changing lives and situations for the better.

When you choose to be a force for good, you’ll have mentors who empower your growth along a purposeful career path. You align your life’s work with an ongoing mission that’s bigger than all of us. As you care for others, you’re cared for with competitive compensation and benefits. You join a community that respects who you are away from work as much as what you do while at work.

Where Your Career is a Force for Good!

We are currently seeking a Senior Director, Government Relations for our Government Relations Department. The location for this position is flexible with the U.S., but you must be open to working east coast hours.

NOTE: The application deadline for this position is Friday, August 14th, 2026 at 5:00 PM ET.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW

The Senior Director, Government Relations Serves as one of the organization’s senior leaders and must have expertise in the aforementioned issue areas. Responsible for forging and maintaining relationships with Members of Congress, key staff and selected agency officials. The Director must be able to develop strategic and tactical plans around relationship building and execution of the ARC’s business priorities. Interprets, recommends and executes the organization’s priorities by providing expert analysis on legislation and regulations. Essential skills include: Strategic analytical ability, ability to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, exceptional written and oral communication skills, superior public policy acumen, political sophistication and ability to work with senior elected officials and the staff. The Director must be able to confidently represent the business priorities of the organization at the highest levels of government and with key stakeholder groups and be able to anticipate future issues that impact the Red Cross.

Perform all duties and responsibilities in alignment with the Fundamental Principles and in compliance with standard operating procedures and other applicable Federal, State, and local regulations.

PAY INFORMATION: The salary range for this position is $175,000- $200,000 This position is not eligible for relocation.

Note that American Red Cross salaries are aligned to the specific geographic location in which the work is primarily performed. Other factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills, how many years of experience you have and comparison to other employees already in this role.

WHERE YOUR CAREER IS A FORCE GOOD

  • Drive a Comprehensive Legislative Advocacy Strategy by advancing federal, state, and local policy priorities and cultivating relationships with key elected officials, government stakeholders, and coalition partners.

  • Focus areas include tax policy, labor and employment policy, ethics and compliance, Red Cross field support.

  • Lead Strategic Government Relations Engagement across assigned regions, ensuring alignment between national policy objectives and state and local advocacy efforts.

  • Advise and Empower Field Leadership by providing government relations expertise, legislative strategy, and policy guidance to Red Cross field operations.

  • Build and Strengthen Influential Policymaker Relationships with members of Congress, state legislators, local officials, and executive branch stakeholders to advance organizational priorities.

  • Mobilize Grassroots and Grasstops Advocacy Efforts by equipping chapters, volunteers, and community leaders to effectively support legislative and policy initiatives at all levels of government.

  • Analyze and Anticipate Policy Developments by monitoring legislative, regulatory, and political trends, assessing potential impacts, and providing strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

  • Develop Policy and Advocacy Resources including legislative briefings, issue papers, testimony, hearing preparation materials, policy analyses, and executive-level talking points.

  • Represent Organizational Interests Before Government Bodies by supporting legislative hearings, stakeholder meetings, coalition activities, and direct advocacy engagements.

  • Strengthen Field Government Relations Capacity through training, coaching, and strategic consultation to enhance advocacy effectiveness and policy influence across assigned regions.

  • Foster Strategic Alignment Across the Enterprise by ensuring consistent execution of government relations priorities and facilitating collaboration between national and field-based teams.

  • Provide Executive Counsel on Legislative Strategy by delivering timely intelligence, political analysis, and actionable insights to support organizational decision-making and advocacy investments.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

  • Extensive knowledge of policies that impact the non-profit sector, particularly tax laws affecting charitable giving.

  • Experience working with the Senate Finance Committee and/or House Ways and Means Committee to include current relationships with key Members and/or staff.

  • ​Ability to brief Red Cross leadership on issues and opportunities before the Congress and recommend ideas and actions to accomplish Red Cross goals.

  • Responsible for developing legislative/regulatory strategic plans with the SVP to advance the Red Cross public policy agenda and assist the other team members in this process.

  • Responsible for developing one pagers, other collateral, and testimony.

  • Excellent communicator with stellar verbal and oral skills who can advocate on behalf of the organization and influence elected officials.

  • Possess an understanding of complex legislative/regulatory issues, assumes a persuasive, thoughtful demeanor and can engage with many diverse audiences.

  • Serves as the organization’s expert on lobbying disclosure and Congressional ethics requirements.

  • Represents the American Red Cross at a senior level on non-profit coalitions and interacts with these coalitions at a senior level.

  • Provides guidance and strategic insight for state legislative initiatives, including developing policy, advancing legislation and implementing outreach and communication.

  • Identifies opportunities to further strengthen relationships across corporate departments and in the field; continues to strategically align state relations efforts with Red Cross priorities to help ensure more effective and efficient partnerships.

  • Must possess strong interpersonal skills.

  • Knowledge of emergency management and disaster response is a plus.

Education: Bachelor's degree required. A Juris Doctor (J.D.) or other advanced degree is a plus.

Experience: Minimum of 10 years of related experience or equivalent combination of education and related experience required.

Management Experience: 7 years of management experience.

Skills & Abilities: Ability to work on a team. Ability to plan, prioritize and organize work to maximize team performance and meet customer expectations. Excellent organizational skills and ability to work with attention to detail. Strong project management skills. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to create and maintain collaborative work relationships within the organization and with external stakeholders. Refined critical thinking, analysis and problem-solving skills and the ability to establish and adjust to current and emerging priorities and negotiate multiple complex activities.

Travel: Travel is required throughout the Region. Some out-of-region travel may also be required.

BENEFITS FOR YOU:
We take care of you, while you take care of others. As a mission-based organization, we believe our team needs great support to do great work. Our comprehensive benefits help you in balancing home and work. With our resources and perks, you have amazing possibilities at the American Red Cross to advance the learn.

  • Medical, Dental Vision plans

  • Health Spending Accounts & Flexible Spending Accounts

  • PTO: Starting at 15 days a year; based on FLSA status and tenure

  • Holidays: 11 paid holidays comprised of six core holidays and five floating holidays

  • 401K with up to 6% match

  • Paid Family Leave

  • Employee Assistance

  • Disability and Insurance: Short + Long Term

  • Service Awards and recognition

Physical Requirements

Physical requirements are those present in normal office environment conditions. Operational flexibility is required to meet sudden and unpredictable needs. Ability to use a personal computer, applicable software, and office equipment for sustained periods of time. May include sitting for long periods of time, driving a vehicle, and working under challenging conditions.

Apply now! Joining our team will provide you with the opportunity to

make your career a force for good!

raw.description:
CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 9,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture.

A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You’ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down.

CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program.

Position Overview:

The Loan Officer Assistant provides support to CrossCountry Mortgage, LLC’s (“CCM”) mortgage loan officers in their daily duties to increase loan production levels. The Loan Officer Assistant works directly with CCM customers, loan officers, and processors to ensure a positive customer experience and facilitate timely loan closings.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Assist in reviewing mortgage loan application and documentation, which may include phone and computer work, printing, copying, scanning, emailing, overnighting documents, etc.

  • Review mortgage loan disclosure packages and deliver them to the borrower.

  • Create rate disclosure and re-disclosure packages and deliver them to the borrower.

  • Review documents and entire loan files and work to prevent problems by highlighting deficiencies and then notifying the mortgage loan officer and/or loan processor.

  • Clarify/correct information and obtain additional information, as necessary, via phone, email, etc.

  • General clerical and phone support to loan officers and/or loan processors, as needed.

  • Work with management to provide support in various stages and areas of lending and processing as needed.

  • Assist in managing a pipeline consisting of conventional, FHA, VA, and USDA loans, along with 203K and reverse mortgage products.

  • Deliver appraisals and/or property valuations to the borrower and retrieve proof of receipt.

  • Track outstanding items on all loan files and follow up with customers to ensure timely receipt of necessary documentation.

  • Facilitate timely loan closings by working directly with the Title Company and customer to schedule.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • High School Diploma, General Equivalency Diploma (GED), or equivalent.

  • A minimum of 1 year of mortgage-related experience, including customer contact.

  • Previous sales support experience, preferred.

  • Salesforce experience, preferred.

  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.

  • Excellent prioritization and time management skills.

  • Proficient with Microsoft Office applications.

This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the job and the general nature and level of work performed by job holders within this job. However, this job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of qualifications, skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the position.

LMI is seeking a Contract Writing System Intructional Designer with significant experience in DoD contracting to support a DoD customer with their deployment of a new contract writing system solutions. LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Provide subject matter expertise in eLearning development working closely with cross-functional leads, project managers, and SMEs to ensure that processes and products meet both tactical and strategic needs of the customer.
  • Participates in the development of technical and functional documentation for various project deliverables and phases.
  • Supports sustainment and execution of organizational change management and strategic communication plans and manage project schedules.
  • Participates in planning, implementation, stakeholder engagement and sustainment activities associated with current and future DoD contract writing systems.
  • Participates in technical risk and change management activities and approaches and communicating those activities to senior DoD customer leadership.
  • Participates in the development, review, and delivery of technical project artifacts and deliverables.
  • Reviews the project status on a regular basis with DoD customers and program stakeholders.
  • Performs procurement system functional support and communication efforts adhering to current processes as well as promote knowledge sharing.
  • Applies experience, knowledge, to the development of training content and delivery of training material to enhance the DoD users’ ability to train on and understand the capabilities and features of the Contract Writing System.
  • Supports the preparation, conduct, and evaluation of technical training programs through virtual sessions. The candidate will participate in developing and writing training materials specific to the COTS product for the DoD customer and will design training content and exercises to enhance user understanding while leveraging practical experience from a contracting and acquisition perspective.

  • Continuously evaluates and hones communication skills.

Qualifications

MINIMUM:

  • Has experience developing targeted communications and training for the purpose of building core shared knowledge and resolving repeating incidents, service requests, and problems.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, with 5+ years of experience in Federal government contracting and/or program management office contracting business processes.
  • Ability to work cohesively in a team-oriented matrix organization environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to listen and empathize and relate to the customer.
  • Ability to effectively collaborate with both internal and external customers.
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving acumen.
  • Excellent organization and time management skills.
  • Ability to obtain a Secret clearance (and interim) in a timely manner.

DESIRED:

  • Possesses an advanced understanding of the contracting user community, and the ability to develop targeted communications and training for the purpose of building core shared knowledge and resolving repeating incidents, service requests, and problems.
  • 5+ years of warranted contracting officer experience.
  • 2+ years in developing and delivering a comprehensive application training curriculum.
  • 2+ years of contract writing system training experience.

Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

You'll own a portfolio of 4–6 B2B accounts. That means running Power Circuit (our proprietary diagnostic system) to identify what's actually constraining each client's growth, building the strategy around that diagnosis, and holding the team accountable for executing it.

The B2B version of this job involves the client's sales team as much as their marketing team. Lead quality, ICP definition, pipeline conversion, win rates — these come up in every QBR. You need to be comfortable having those conversations with a VP of Sales who is skeptical of marketing's contribution.

Responsibilities:

  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
  • Run quarterly Power Circuit reviews for each account — diagnose growth constraints across all six pillars (Business, Audience, Product, Messaging, Channels, Measurement) and build the roadmap from the findings
  • Work directly with client sales leadership on ICP refinement, lead scoring criteria, MQL→SQL handoff quality, and pipeline health
  • Own the senior client relationship; QBRs should address revenue, not recap campaigns
  • Coordinate paid, SEO, content, ABM, and creative work around a single account strategy
  • Manage retention and expansion; lead renewals; grow MRR in your portfolio
  • Build multi-threaded relationships with multiple layers of client contacts so no single point of contact departure puts an account at risk
  • Ensure daily use of our proprietary technology (Iris and nova), Pulse (client performance and sentiment tool) cadence at 100%, and Power Circuit (our diagnostic system) compliance across managed ADs
  • Coach and give direct feedback to analysts and specialists on your accounts

Role Requirements:

  • 6+ years in B2B marketing, with client-facing or consultative experience
  • Has worked with sales teams directly — understands why the MQL→SQL handoff breaks and how to fix it
  • Fluent in B2B-specific dynamics: buying committees, long sales cycles, high-ACV pipeline, CAC in enterprise contexts
  • Knows B2B measurement well enough to have an opinion — pipeline attribution, MMM limitations in long-cycle sales, when last-touch is misleading
  • Has presented to VP and C-suite stakeholders and pushed back on them when the data supported it
  • Track record of retaining and growing accounts
  • ABM strategy experience, not just execution

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Expansion to Churn Ratio (ETCR)
  • Net MRR across portfolio
  • Client NPS (8+ avg)
  • Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
  • Power Circuit Certification (annual)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Team Coaching and Development
  • Marketing Strategy, Development and Execution
  • Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs
  • National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Job Title: Minute Clinic Virtual Care Nurse Practitioner - PRN

Job Location: Work at Home, Texas, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

This is a 6-month PRN contract position; provider must be able to provide a minimum of 9 hours of availability per week including every third weekend. The available shift times are evening (2:30p - 11p) and overnight (9p - 6:30a).
Qualified candidates must hold a current, unrestricted license in AL, AR, CO, IA, ID, IN, LA, MI, MS, NE, NV, OK, TN, or TX. If hired, must be willing and able to obtain additional licensure.

The Minute Clinic Virtual Care Nurse Practitioner (Provider) delivers patient care services through a remote technology platform. You will work in collaboration with a dedicated team of professionals as you independently provide holistic, evidenced based care inclusive of accurate assessment, diagnosis, treatment, management of health problems, health counseling, and disposition planning for our patients ranging in age 18 months and above. Encounters are documented utilizing Epic.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT:

  • Dedicated virtual care providers must meet minimum requirements for remote care delivery, including: broadband connectivity, a quiet setting with a neutral background to conduct visits from, and the ability to uphold patient privacy per CVSH guidelines. Ability to hardwire into connection preferred.

  • While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to interact with customers in a remote manner, site, write, operate the computer and phone, speak intelligibly, and hear patient responses.

  • Specific vision abilities include the ability to view and read a computer screen and other electronic devices

Responsibilities:

  • Provide holistic, evidenced based care inclusive of accurate assessment, diagnosis, treatment, management of health problems, health counseling, and disposition planning for our patients. This includes education and treatment for pregnancy prevention, STI Prevention and safer sex practices.

  • Evaluate primary care, acute, chronically ill, and transitional care patients, in addition to providing healthcare education and counseling, and disposition planning for our patients ranging in age 18 months and above.

  • Provide patient counseling; inclusive of pregnancy prevention, STI Prevention/safer sex practices, contraceptive care counseling and medication management

  • Educate patients on health maintenance and respond to patient care inquiries

  • Document all patient care within an EHR according to MinuteClinic policies and procedures

  • Provide care and coordination of our patients with internal and external colleagues, including the broader patient centered medical home, ensuring the highest standard of care is provided for all patients.

  • Effectively work within a patient care team, including fellow Providers, Collaborative Physicians, paraprofessionals, Pharmacists and other members of the health care team

  • Work independently , prioritize and solve problems, take initiative, and advocate for their patients and their practice

Required Qualifications:

  • Candidates must be currently licensed in one of the following states to be considered: AL, AR, CO, IA, ID, IN, LA, MI, MS, NE, NV, OK, TN, or TX

  • Minimum of two years of medically-relevant experience or equivalent

  • Effective verbal, written, and electronic communication skills

  • Outstanding organizational skills and ability to multi-task

  • Initiative, problem solving ability, adaptability and flexibility

  • Ability to work without direct supervision and practice autonomously

  • Is proficient with information management and technology

  • Capacity to collaborate with professional colleagues as necessary to provide quality care

  • Depending on the market, the ability to be proficient in both speaking and writing in additional languages not limited to but including Spanish may be required

Education:

Completion of a Master’s Degree level Family Nurse Practitioner program with current National Board Certification and State of Employment license to practice in the Advanced Practice Nurse role required

$37.66 - $90.13

The Vice President, Finance Data Strategy & Governance is a senior Finance executive responsible for defining and executing the Finance data strategy to improve business performance, forecasting, financial reporting, governance, controls, and enterprise decision-making. As a member of the Finance leadership team, this leader partners with Finance executives, business leaders, Technology, Data, Risk, Compliance, and Operations to establish the Finance data agenda and deliver scalable data capabilities.

This role leads the Finance data strategy, transformation roadmap, data product portfolio, governance framework, stewardship model, and adoption strategy to ensure Finance data is trusted, governed, accessible, and aligned with enterprise priorities across financial reporting, planning, forecasting, treasury, regulatory reporting, analytics, and executive decision support.

What You Will Do

  • Serve as a senior member of the Finance leadership team, contributing to Finance strategy, operating priorities, transformation initiatives, and executive decision-making.

  • Define and execute the Finance data strategy aligned with enterprise business objectives, technology strategy, regulatory requirements, and Finance transformation goals.

  • Develop and maintain a multi-year Finance data roadmap that prioritizes strategic initiatives, investments, governance, modernization, and measurable business outcomes.

  • Advise executive leadership on Finance data investments, prioritization, business value, risks, and technology trade-offs.

  • Partner with Finance, Technology, Enterprise Data, Analytics, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Treasury, Architecture, and Operations leaders to align enterprise data initiatives with Finance priorities.

  • Represent Finance in enterprise data governance and technology governance forums.

  • Own the Finance data product portfolio, including financial reporting datasets, semantic models, business metrics, APIs, dashboards, analytical assets, and reusable data products.

  • Lead adoption of a product-based operating model for Finance data, including product lifecycle management, prioritization, stakeholder engagement, adoption measurement, and value realization.

  • Provide Finance business ownership for enterprise data platforms, ERP integrations, planning systems, treasury systems, regulatory reporting platforms, and analytics environments.

  • Partner with Data Engineering, Technology, and Architecture teams to deliver scalable, secure, automated, and high-quality Finance data solutions.

  • Establish and lead the Finance data governance framework, stewardship model, governance councils, policies, standards, and operating procedures.

  • Define accountability for Finance data ownership, data quality, metadata management, issue resolution, lifecycle management, and stewardship across critical Finance domains.

  • Standardize Finance business definitions, master data, reference data, metadata, hierarchies, KPIs, business glossaries, and data lineage.

  • Ensure Finance data practices support SOX compliance, audit readiness, regulatory reporting, privacy requirements, and enterprise control standards.

  • Establish transparent and auditable Finance data processes supporting executive reporting, regulatory reporting, planning, forecasting, and operational decision-making.

  • Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams responsible for Finance data strategy, governance, data products, and stewardship.

  • Drive organizational change by promoting data literacy, governance adoption, stewardship accountability, and standardized Finance metrics.

  • Establish and monitor KPIs measuring data quality, adoption, governance effectiveness, business value, stakeholder satisfaction, and operational performance.

  • Communicate strategy, progress, risks, outcomes, and transformation milestones to executive leadership.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Data Management, Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related discipline; equivalent experience considered.

  • 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in Finance data management, Finance transformation, enterprise data strategy, analytics, finance systems, data governance, or data product management.

  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise-scale Finance data transformation, governance, analytics, or platform modernization initiatives.

  • Experience developing and executing multi-year strategic roadmaps and organizational transformation programs.

  • Experience partnering with executive leadership across Finance, Technology, Enterprise Data, Risk, Compliance, and business functions.

  • Strong knowledge of:

    • Financial reporting

    • Financial planning and analysis (FP&A)

    • Forecasting

    • Regulatory reporting

    • SOX compliance

    • Internal controls

    • Audit requirements

    • Data governance

    • Data quality management

    • Master Data Management (MDM)

    • Metadata management

    • Business glossaries

    • Data lineage

    • Data stewardship

    • Enterprise data management

    • Data product management

    • Change management

  • Experience establishing governance frameworks, stewardship programs, data ownership models, and enterprise data standards.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate Finance priorities into scalable technology and data solutions.

  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing executive stakeholders without direct authority.

  • Strong executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

What Will Set You Apart

  • MBA, CPA, CFA, or other advanced degree.

  • Financial services, banking, retirement, asset management, insurance, or other highly regulated industry experience.

  • Experience with SAP ERP, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW, SAP Datasphere, or other enterprise ERP platforms.

  • Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.

  • Experience with enterprise reporting and analytics platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, SAP Analytics Cloud, or similar.

raw.description:
Who is Sharesource?

We are a social enterprise dedicated to connecting global opportunities with talented individuals. Currently, we serve Australian clients and aim to empower businesses to thrive by accessing the talent they need worldwide. Our mission is to support individuals in achieving success in their careers while fostering a company culture that embodies our values.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a proactive and results-driven Digital Marketing Specialist with strong experience in paid advertising, content creation, and social media management. This role will focus on driving growth through high-performing campaigns, particularly across Meta and Google platforms, while supporting overall digital marketing efforts in a fast-paced, startup environment.

The ideal candidate has strong written communication skills, a problem-solving mindset, and the ability to take ownership of campaigns and continuously optimise performance.

What are you expected to do?

  • Plan, execute, and optimise Meta (Facebook & Instagram) and Google Ads campaigns, focusing on performance, conversions, and revenue growth.
  • Create engaging and on-brand content for social media, including captions, visuals, and campaign creatives.
  • Manage day-to-day social media operations, including scheduling, engagement, and responding to comments and inquiries.
  • Support email marketing campaigns, including content creation and execution.
  • Monitor and analyse campaign performance across paid and organic channels, providing insights and recommendations.
  • Continuously test and improve ad creatives, targeting, and strategies to maximise ROI.
  • Maintain and update product or campaign-related content on Shopify as needed.
  • Use tools like Canva (and occasionally Adobe tools) to produce marketing assets.
  • Collaborate with the team to develop new ideas, campaigns, and growth strategies.
  • Contribute to a culture of proactivity and continuous improvement in a fast-growing business.

You’ll be a great fit if:

  • You have 3-5 years of experience in digital marketing, with a strong focus on Meta Ads and Google Ads.
  • You have strong written communication skills, particularly for email and online engagement.
  • You have the ability to manage campaigns and social media channels independently.
  • You have familiarity with Shopify, Canva, and/or Adobe design tools (training can be provided).
  • You have an analytical mindset with the ability to interpret performance data and optimise campaigns.

  • You are self-motivated, organised, and comfortable working remotely.

It would be desirable if:

  • You have experience in e-commerce marketing.

  • You have familiarity with email marketing tools.

  • You have basic design skills using Adobe tools.

  • You take ownership and proactively improve campaign performance.

  • You enjoy testing, learning, and scaling what works.

  • You thrive in a startup environment with rapid growth and evolving priorities.

  • You are open to feedback and contribute ideas to improve marketing outcomes.

Please note: This role is remote; however, we require candidates to be based locally in Vietnam. This is to support occasional onsite activities such as team events, client meetings, or equipment handover. Additionally, local residency is necessary for compliance with Vietnam labor laws and employment regulations.

Why work for Sharesource?

Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire hundreds of skillful individuals from a wide variety of backgrounds, genders, ages, and personalities to live out our diverse culture and make a positive impact on the world!

Our 5 Values:

  • Make a social impact: We balance our work for client teams and for society by constantly making a positive impact.
  • Be proactive: We encourage brave thinking and continuous improvement, and drive change through action.
  • Create value: We create measurable values for our stakeholders: our teams, partners, suppliers, investors, and communities.
  • Be fair, open and honest: We foster equality and inclusivity in a supportive environment that embraces diversity and celebrates achievements.
  • Add fun, passion and love: We prioritise fun and passion, fostering higher engagement and a positive can-do attitude.

What to Expect in the Process?

  1. You’ll go through 3–4 interviews plus a possible assessment with our client partner. This includes an initial chat, a culture-fit interview, and 1–2 conversations with our awesome client. The whole process usually takes 1–2 weeks, but we’ll let you know if things need to move quicker.
  2. Our best advice? Be yourself and enjoy the conversations. We’ll keep you updated every step of the way, and you’re always welcome to reach out for updates anytime.
  3. If all goes well, we’ll complete reference checks and requirements quickly—so we can get that job offer to you without delay.

We would be grateful if you have these already:

  • Health Check-up

  • Identification Card/Passport

  • Social Insurance Number

  • Personal Income Tax Number

  • Character references with contact info

At Sharesource, we believe in the value of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to creating a diverse, respectful, and inclusive workplace, and we do not discriminate based on factors such as race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

Experience a Career at ProAg

When you join ProAg, you join a welcoming, dynamic, flexible, and engaging culture that truly cares about each other, our agents and our policyholders. Here, you’ll learn and grow as we help you as you create a career that’s meaningful to you.

ProAg, a member of Tokio Marine HCC group of companies, is looking for a dynamic, ambitious District Sales Manager in Minnesota. This is an individual contributor role that offers an immense opportunity to develop strategic relationships with current and potential producers of profitable business within Minnesota, Iowa and Nebraska.

In This Exciting Opportunity, You Will:

  • Develop a strategic territory plan by identifying and meeting with prospective agents regarding ProAg’s insurance offerings. Drive additional business through a variety of means including agency visits, social events, trade shows, and correspondence.

  • Meet or exceed sales goals for both existing and new business within Minnesota, along with developing and maintaining a database of current and prospective agents.

  • Serve as a primary relationship owner, trusted advisor, and point of contact for assigned agent accounts to help them grow and manage their business.

  • Become a subject-matter expert on ProAg’s products, business, and applications, as well as staying up-to-date on industry trends. Gain and maintain a clear understanding of Crop Insurance and ProAg’s Standard Reinsurance Agreement.

  • Monitor competitor and industry trends to identify trends and changes in the marketplace

  • Collaborate with internal resources as necessary to prepare for and deliver necessary training or educational events with regional training staff on ProAg programs, products, and technology.

  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies and government regulations.

  • Perform other relevant duties and projects assigned.

What You’ll Bring:

The ideal candidate for the District Sales Manager will have demonstrated success in the primary areas of focus and responsibility.

  • Ideally, the successful candidate will have at least two years of sales experience, crop insurance experience preferred.

  • Must be an exceptional communicator with the ability to facilitate cross-functionally to ensure clear and expeditious communication.

  • Knowledge of industry changes, legal updates, and technical developments related to applicable area of the Company’s business to proactively respond to changing business environment.

  • Required to travel outside normal work location, travel is up to 75%

  • Must have the ability to work independently, focusing on achieving organizational goals and tasks with drive and energy to succeed.

  • The ability to build trust and relationships with key constituencies.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Salary and comprehensive benefit package

  • Strong learning culture with ongoing development opportunities

  • Opportunities for growth and career advancement

  • Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, with eligibility beginning on your first day of employment

  • Basic life and disability insurance

  • 401(k) plan with 6% company match

  • 20 days of PTO, three floating holidays, approximately 10 paid holidays, and volunteer time off

  • Paid parental leave

  • Access to our award-winning wellness program, including mental health services, fitness network memberships, and a complimentary Headspace subscription

  • Student loan matching program

  • Employee discount program

  • An opportunity to do meaningful work and love what you do

What We Represent:

A career with purpose. Our crop insurance professionals work each day to bring peace of mind and protection to American farmers and ranchers. Join a team who truly cares.

  • Part of something bigger: We offer a career with purpose as you support the farmers and ranchers who create food, fuel, and fiber for the world.

  • Personal connections: We are built on strong relationships and appreciation of your individuality.

  • A team who cares: We look out for each other personally and professionally because we care about each other.

  • Innovators by trade: We’re committed to a brighter tomorrow for our team members and agriculture.

  • The best of both worlds: We combine personal connections with powerful resources, thanks to our culture and the backing of Tokio Marine HCC.

The Company:

ProAg, a member of the Tokio Marine HCC group of companies, is positioned as a financially strong and well-capitalized insurer with an AM Best rating of A++. With 100 years of service to our agents & insureds, we stand committed to continuing the principles that ProAg was founded on: Integrity, Loyalty, and Customer Service.

Tokio Marine HCC is a leading specialty insurance group with offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, and other exciting locations. With the strength and stability that comes from being a member of the Tokio Marine Group, and more than fifty years of growth, profitability, and stability, we offer important insurance products that most people don’t even know exist. Every policy we write is special, enabling our clients to do amazing things.

Where not restricted by law and for criminal history not covered by this law, the Company will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history in compliance with applicable law.

raw.description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled Mobile App Developers (React Native, Flutter, Swift, or Kotlin) to join the Tendem project () and build native and cross-platform mobile applications for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your mobile engineering expertise to build stable, performant, and user-friendly applications for iOS and Android. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience shipping iOS and/or Android apps, working with platform APIs, and handling the full mobile development lifecycle.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Mobile App Developer, you'll design, build, and refine mobile applications across categories such as utilities, fitness/wellness, games, productivity, delivery, and content apps — for iOS, Android, or both, using native or cross-platform frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build mobile applications using React Native, Flutter, Swift (iOS), or Kotlin (Android).
  • Implement responsive mobile UIs that follow platform conventions (iOS HIG, Material Design).
  • Integrate native device features (camera, push notifications, location, storage, biometrics).
  • Connect apps to backend APIs, handle offline state, caching, and synchronization.
  • Implement monetization features where required (in-app purchases, ads, subscriptions).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor mobile application code to improve correctness, performance, battery efficiency, and maintainability.
  • Debug platform-specific issues and prepare builds for distribution (TestFlight, Play Console).

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in mobile app development (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in mobile application development, platform-specific UI/UX patterns, and building stable, high-quality mobile experiences for iOS and Android. We are looking for specialists who can confidently work with native or cross-platform frameworks, integrate device APIs and backend services, and build production-ready mobile applications. Strong attention to detail, performance awareness, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: React Native, Flutter, Swift/SwiftUI (iOS), or Kotlin/Jetpack Compose (Android).
  • Solid understanding of mobile UI patterns, navigation, state management, and platform guidelines.
  • Experience integrating REST APIs, handling async data, and managing local storage.
  • Familiarity with native device APIs (notifications, camera, location, storage, biometrics).
  • Experience with mobile build tools, code signing, and submission to App Store / Google Play.
  • Experience implementing in-app purchases, ads, or subscriptions is a plus.
  • Familiarity with backend services such as Firebase, Supabase, or similar is a plus.

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to performance, stability, and platform polish.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to ship complete mobile features independently.
  • Portfolio of shipped mobile apps (required, with App Store / Google Play links preferred).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $35 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

title: Growth Product Manager (RnD Officer)

raw.title: Growth Product Manager (RnD Officer)
raw.excerpt: “Ми вже довели, що вміємо будувати продукти світового рівня.
raw.description:
Ми вже довели, що вміємо будувати продукти світового рівня. Тепер йдемо у нові для себе ринки й напрями – і шукаємо того, хто горить новим, готовий зайнятись RnD з нуля й вирости до керівника власного напряму.
Ми, Honeytech — компанія, що розвиває платформи з коміксами та аніме та вже стала #1 у своїй ніші. Уяви Netflix, але для коміксів — лише за кілька років ми зібрали 20+ мільйонів користувачів, кинули виклик гігантам з Південної Кореї й довели, що можемо будувати продукт світового рівня з України! Наша експертна команда налічує понад 80 спеціалістів та зростає більше ніж у 2.5 раза щороку.

Момент, у якому ми зараз:
Наш основний продукт уже лідер у своїй ніші, й тепер ми розглядаємо вихід на нові суміжні ринки. Шукаємо Growth Product Manager (RnD Officer), який буде шукати нові точки росту, тестувати гіпотези, рісьорчити й аналізувати нові напрямки для росту бізнесу.

Що ти отримаєш від роботи з нами:
  • 🚀 Свободу обирати точки росту: ти сам вирішуєш, які гіпотези тестувати, розвиваєш успішні напрями та збираєш під них команду.
  • 🤝 Жодного мікроменеджменту: в нашій команді немає контролю над кожним кроком, й ми чекаємо на твої успішні ідеї!
  • 📈 Прямий вплив на бізнес: ти бачиш, як твої рішення конвертуються в метрики й прибуток компанії.
  • 🧪 Простір для експериментів: RnD — це твоя зона, де можна тестувати ідеї та запускати нове.
Ти наш ідеальний колега, якщо маєш:
  • 2+ рокипродуктового досвіду у B2C (досвід із підписочними моделями буде плюсом);
  • Розумієшся на performance marketing та user acquisition;
  • Працюєш із воронкою — бачиш, де падає конверсія, і знаєш, як її підняти;
  • Вмієш зводити юніт-економіку та перевіряєш гіпотези на цифрах;
  • Маєш аналітичне мислення: не йдеш у «сухі цифри», але впевнено розумієш, як вони працюють;
  • Вмієш організовувати процеси та команду;
  • Маєш growth mindset: постійно шукаєш нові точки росту й можливості для масштабування;
  • Вмієш “продавати” ідеї, запалювати команду й працювати автономно;
  • Володієш англійською на рівні Upper-Intermediate та вище
Твоя майбутня зона відповідальності:
  • Знаходити точки росту продукту та перетворювати їх на гіпотези та експерименти;
  • Підхоплювати суміжні напрями: підтримувати команду, докручувати продукт і виводити його показники вгору;
  • Запускати та тестувати нові ринки й напрями;
  • Будувати й оптимізувати воронку, зводити юніт-економіку, працювати з конверсіями та LTV;
  • Разом із UA/маркетинг командою шукати ефективні зв'язки для масштабування;
  • Приносити нові продуктові ідеї та напрями для розвитку й доводити їх від гіпотези до результату.
Цікаво, що ще пропонуємо?
  • Віддалена робота або можливість працювати з нашого офісу в Києві, що повністю обладнаний для роботи під час відключень світла + можливість користуватися коворкінгом у Варшаві та Львові.
  • 20 робочих днів відпустки на рік (після 3 місяців співпраці) та до 30 днів sick leave з медичним підтвердженням. А також можливість трансферу робочих днів та days off по державних святах України.
  • Веселі тімбілдінги та корпоративні подорожі.
  • Програма HoneyFit — компенсація спортивних активностей та івентів, оффлайн/онлайн тренувань тощо (по завершенню випробувального терміну).
  • Різноманітні можливості для навчання: доповіді спікерів у різноманітних напрямах, велика корпоративна бібліотека, компенсація зовнішніх курсів і, звичайно, уроки англійської мови + speaking clubs.
  • Допомога в релокації, оплата коворкінгів або допомога у придбанні зарядних станцій та облаштування home office (після 3х місяців співпраці).
  • Але найголовніше: Honeytech — це команда професіоналів, де кожний відчуває підтримку та досягає своїх цілей!
Готовий будувати нові напрями та перемагати разом з нами? Надсилай своє резюме!

raw.description:
Req ID:371046

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Strategic Pursuit Leader to join our Client Growth team. This role will primarily focus on large deals ($50M+). This role will work remotely from your home office located within the US with travel required as necessary.

Overview: The Pursuit Leader is a single threaded leader responsible for managing and orchestrating end-to-end strategic pursuit cycle. They create an account engagement plan and own its execution. During early stages, they will review the client-facing point of view, and compelling value propositions and provide feedback from a deal shaping perspective. They influence, orchestrate, and facilitate internal alignment to remove blockers and achieve desired business outcomes.

The Pursuit Leader will clearly understand the value drivers, value proposition, transformation angle, stakeholder map (including board relationships), competitive landscape, decision process and timeline, including clarity of the approval path. Based on this they create an actionable Pursuit Strategy / Win Strategy) that clearly articulates what we need to do to win, and continually refresh that as the pursuit progresses. They must continually develop and refine the understanding of “who amongst the client executives need to believe what, and what needs to be true for the client to do the deal with NTT DATA”. They continually leverage the value proposition to align the stakeholders to the value proposition and shape/create a deal. Lastly, from a key renewals perspective, this function will create a process for high value renewals - encompassing assessment, strategy, and execution, and will work with the Industry Leaders to roll it out.

Job Responsibilities Include:

  • Own the creation and execution of strategic pursuit engagement plans, collaborating with team members and across the company to ensure continued alignment and action.
  • Engage early with customer technology and business leaders to build relationships and gather a deep understanding of the customer’s current needs and challenges.
  • Manage customer relationship from origination to closure of complex, multi-tower high value proposals.
  • Create win strategies that address the business goals and technology needs of a customer.
  • Lead the solution design, construction and orchestration across NTT, partners and client organizations.
  • Work collaboratively across multi-solution and cross-functional organization with Sales, Client Executives, Consulting Engagement Leads, Solution/Enterprise Architects, and Client Delivery, and Operations teams to ensure that the proposed solution aligns with the customer's business goals and requirements.
  • Communicate effectively with customers, sales teams, delivery teams, and stakeholders to ensure alignment and clarity of the solution vision, scope, and value proposition.
  • Stay abreast of the latest trends, technologies, and best practices in the enterprise architecture domain and leverage them to create innovative and competitive solutions.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 12 years of experience in enterprise sales, complex, multi-tower deal pursuits, or consulting sales roles, preferably in the IT services industry.
  • Proven experience leading deals of >50M, ideally >100M
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience (i.e. 4 additional years of work experience).

Preferred Skills:

  • Proven record of accomplishment of managing and closing complex deal cycyles that meet customer requirements and expectations.
  • Strong knowledge and experience in various technology domains, such as cloud, data, security, network, infrastructure, applications, etc.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts and solutions clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic, and collaborative environment, with multiple stakeholders and teams.

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. Responsible for creation of drawings for substation engineering design projects including detailed civil/structural design for high voltage substation projects.

· Site plans.

· Peer review of other’s drawings.

· Site plans.

  • Ability to work well with others in a team setting

raw.title: Integrating Firmware Engineer-Mesh
raw.excerpt: OverviewLMI is seeking an Integrating Firmware Engineer to support the development and integration of embedded firmware for next-generation mesh networking products used by Department of Defense customers.
raw.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking an Integrating Firmware Engineer to support the development and integration of embedded firmware for next-generation mesh networking products used by Department of Defense customers. This role is ideal for an engineer looking to build experience across multiple areas of embedded systems while working alongside senior firmware, RF, and cybersecurity engineers.

The Integrating Firmware Engineer will help implement firmware changes supporting the Nordic nRF54L Series platform, assist with hardware integration, contribute to rapid GNSS location capabilities, and support the team’s continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) environment.

U.S. citizenship is required. Candidates must be eligible to obtain a Secret security clearance. An active Secret clearance is preferred.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors, helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Develop and modify embedded firmware for the Nordic nRF54L Series platform.
  • Implement firmware updates required to support new hardware features, including GPIO and peripheral configuration changes.
  • Assist in integrating rapid GNSS location determination capabilities into embedded products.
  • Support the RF Firmware Engineer and Cryptography Firmware Engineer with firmware integration, testing, and validation.
  • Participate in hardware bring-up, debugging, and prototype testing activities.
  • Assist with development and maintenance of the team’s CI/CD pipeline for embedded firmware builds and testing.
  • Perform firmware integration testing and support issue resolution across hardware and software components.
  • Collaborate with hardware, firmware, systems, and cybersecurity engineers throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Document firmware changes, testing procedures, and integration activities.
  • Participate in design reviews and technical discussions while building knowledge of embedded system architecture.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related STEM field.
  • 0–2 years of experience in embedded software or firmware development (internships and co-op experience welcomed).
  • Experience programming in C/C++.
  • Basic understanding of embedded microcontrollers and hardware interfaces such as GPIO, SPI, UART, and I2C.
  • Familiarity with embedded debugging tools and development environments.
  • Basic understanding of version control systems such as Git.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to learn quickly and work effectively within a collaborative engineering team.
  • U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain a Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Nordic Semiconductor microcontrollers or similar ARM Cortex-M platforms.
  • Familiarity with RTOS-based embedded development.
  • Exposure to GNSS technologies or wireless communication systems.
  • Familiarity with automated build systems, CI/CD tools, or DevOps concepts.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar automation tools.
  • Internship or academic project experience involving embedded systems or IoT devices.
  • Active Secret security clearance.

Travel

  • Approximately 10–15% travel for engineering collaboration, hardware integration, customer support, and field testing as required.

Target salary range: $60,000 - 95,000

Disclaimer: The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for a U.S. Government security clearance. Only US Citizens are eligible for a security clearance. For this position, LMI will only consider applicants with security clearances or applicants who are eligible for security clearances, due to the nature of the work.

US-Remote

raw.description:
O time de Dados da Controladoria atua no desenvolvimento de soluções e produtos de dados voltados às necessidades das áreas contábil, financeira, fiscal e regulatória, em um contexto corporativo de alta complexidade, criticidade e responsabilidade.

Nosso papel é transformar dados em capacidade analítica, eficiência operacional, suporte à tomada de decisão e segurança para o negócio, sempre com forte compromisso com compliance regulatório, rastreabilidade e qualidade da informação. Atuamos como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia, conectando demandas estratégicas a soluções escaláveis e sustentáveis.

Dentro desse contexto, a pauta da Reforma Tributária representa um dos temas mais relevantes e desafiadores da nossa atuação. Ela exige rapidez de adaptação, inteligência aplicada aos dados, visão sistêmica e construção de soluções capazes de apoiar análises, simulações, decisões e adequações operacionais em um ambiente regulado e em transformação.

Buscamos uma pessoa Engenheira de IA para assumir papel central na evolução das capacidades de Inteligência Artificial no time de Dados da Controladoria, contribuindo diretamente para desafios estratégicos relacionados à Reforma Tributária e a outras frentes críticas do ecossistema financeiro, fiscal e regulatório.

Essa posição vai além da construção técnica de modelos: esperamos uma atuação com visão de produto, arquitetura e negócio, capaz de desenhar, integrar e escalar soluções de IA que gerem impacto real para áreas corporativas complexas. A pessoa terá protagonismo na aplicação de LLMs, agentes, modelos preditivos e arquiteturas corporativas de IA, conectando tecnologia de ponta às demandas do negócio com responsabilidade, robustez e foco em valor.

Será uma atuação estratégica em um ambiente que exige equilíbrio entre inovação, governança, segurança, explicabilidade e sustentabilidade técnica, contribuindo para que a organização esteja preparada para responder com agilidade e inteligência aos impactos da Reforma Tributária e de outras agendas regulatórias.

  • Conduzir o desenvolvimento e a integração de componentes de IA como LLMs, agentes, modelos preditivos e pipelines inteligentes em aplicações e sistemas corporativos voltados a contextos financeiros, fiscais e regulatórios.
  • Participar ativamente da definição da arquitetura técnica das soluções, considerando aspectos como escalabilidade, resiliência, segurança, governança, custo e sustentabilidade de longo prazo.
  • Realizar revisões técnicas e validações críticas de modelos, pipelines, integrações e decisões de arquitetura, assegurando excelência nas entregas e aderência aos padrões de engenharia.
  • Traduzir necessidades estratégicas das áreas de negócio em soluções de IA de alto impacto, atuando com forte interlocução entre times técnicos e stakeholders corporativos.
  • Apoiar a construção de soluções que viabilizem análises, automações, simulações e suporte à decisão em temas relacionados à Reforma Tributária, ampliando a capacidade de resposta da organização diante de mudanças regulatórias.
  • Manter a documentação técnica atualizada, garantindo rastreabilidade, reuso, clareza das decisões de arquitetura e continuidade evolutiva das soluções.
  • Orientar e desenvolver profissionais menos experientes, disseminando boas práticas de engenharia, padrões técnicos e uso responsável de IA no contexto corporativo.
  • Preparar apresentações, materiais técnicos e conteúdos de alinhamento para diferentes públicos, incluindo áreas parceiras, lideranças e stakeholders estratégicos.
  • Participar da priorização de demandas e gestão de escopo, contribuindo para decisões que equilibrem valor de negócio, viabilidade técnica e capacidade de execução.
  • Compartilhar conhecimento sobre frameworks de IA, APIs, microsserviços, padrões de integração e abordagens modernas para construção de aplicações inteligentes.
  • Conduzir discussões técnicas com times de DevOps, Engenharia, Segurança e Arquitetura, promovendo alinhamento e solidez na implantação das soluções.
  • Avaliar tecnologias emergentes, propondo caminhos evolutivos coerentes com a estratégia da empresa, com foco em geração de valor e maturidade tecnológica.
  • Proficiência em Python ou Java, com experiência no uso de bibliotecas e frameworks de IA/ML.
  • Vivência com NLP, visão computacional e IA generativa, incluindo LLMs, agentes, arquiteturas RAG e protocolos como MCP.
  • Domínio de boas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo modularização, testes, observabilidade, versionamento, revisão de código e qualidade de entrega.
  • Experiência com CI/CD, containers (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes).
  • Vivência com serviços de nuvem para deploy, monitoramento e operação de soluções de IA em produção.
  • Capacidade de desenhar integrações entre modelos, APIs, microsserviços e aplicações corporativas.
  • Experiência na documentação de decisões técnicas, modelos, fluxos e arquiteturas, garantindo rastreabilidade e governança.
  • Habilidade para comunicar resultados técnicos de forma clara para áreas de negócio e stakeholders não técnicos.
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções de IA escaláveis e sustentáveis
  • Liderança técnica, com atuação em definição de padrões e orientação de equipes
  • Alta colaboração com áreas de negócio e tecnologia
  • Pensamento crítico e visão sistêmica para revisão e evolução de soluções
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e executivos
  • Interesse contínuo por tendências e uso responsável de IA

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em contextos financeiros, fiscais, contábeis ou regulatórios
  • Vivência com temas ligados à Reforma Tributária ou compliance
  • Experiência com MLOps/LLMOps e operação de IA em produção
  • Atuação com produtos de dados voltados a automação e suporte à decisão
  • Experiência em arquiteturas modernas e ambientes com alta governança de dados

BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals.
