We are seeking a Senior Principal Data Engineer to serve as one of the highest-level technical leaders within the Data Engineering organization. Responsible for defining technical strategy, architecting enterprise-scale data platforms, and delivering scalable, secure, and high-quality data solutions.

This role combines deep expertise in cloud data platforms, software engineering, enterprise data architecture, data modeling, AI-assisted development, and technical governance. The successful candidate will influence technical direction across multiple business domains, establish engineering standards, and mentor engineers while remaining hands-on with architecture and solution design.

Key Responsibilities:

Enterprise Data Architecture

  • Design and evolve enterprise-scale data platform architecture supporting analytical, operational, and AI workloads.
  • Define reusable engineering frameworks, reference architectures, and technical standards.
  • Drive long-term platform strategy focused on scalability, security, performance, and maintainability.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead architecture reviews, technical design, and engineering governance for strategic initiatives.
  • Partner with engineering leadership to define technology roadmaps and drive engineering best practices.
  • Influence technical decisions across multiple teams without direct people management.

Data Engineering & Data Modeling

  • Design scalable ETL/ELT frameworks, enterprise data pipelines, and logical and physical data models.
  • Develop reusable, metadata-driven data integration frameworks.
  • Establish standards for data modeling, metadata management, lineage, and performance optimization.

AI-Driven Engineering

  • Champion AI-assisted software development across the engineering organization.
  • Evaluate and implement AI coding assistants and engineering productivity tools.
  • Build intelligent engineering accelerators, including:
    • AI-assisted code generation
    • Automated documentation
    • Code review assistance
    • Test generation
    • Data quality validation
    • AI-powered engineering copilots
  • Drive engineering productivity and innovation through Generative AI.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Provide technical leadership across modern cloud technologies including:

  • Databricks
  • Azure
  • AWS
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Python
  • SQL
  • Git
  • REST APIs
  • CI/CD

Data Governance & Engineering Excellence

  • Design secure data platforms with enterprise governance, metadata, lineage, and RBAC/ABAC access controls.
  • Establish software engineering best practices including code quality, testing, automation, observability, and reusable components.

Mentorship & Collaboration

  • Mentor senior engineers and principal engineers while fostering engineering excellence.
  • Partner with Product Management, Data Science, Analytics, Data Governance, Enterprise Architecture, and Infrastructure teams to deliver strategic data capabilities.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (Master's preferred).

  • Hands-on experience with Databricks, Azure, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, REST APIs, and CI/CD.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead highly complex technical initiatives through influence rather than direct people management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or other regulated industries.
  • Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog, enterprise data governance, metadata management, and observability.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, or similar).
  • Experience applying Generative AI to software and data engineering.

Leadership Expectations

The Senior Principal Data Engineer is expected to set technical direction, establish engineering standards, accelerate engineering productivity through automation and AI, mentor engineers, and serve as a trusted technical advisor to engineering and business leadership.

Success Metrics

Success will be measured by the scalability, reliability, and security of enterprise data platforms, delivery of strategic initiatives, adoption of reusable engineering frameworks, improvements in engineering productivity through AI, platform quality, and technical influence across the organization.

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback

  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change

Shift Schedule:This is a 12-hour day shift (5:45 PM to 6:15 AM Mountain Time), operating on a 12/7 rotational schedule. The rotation is as follows:

  • Week 1: Work Sunday through Tuesday (3 consecutive days)
  • Week 2: Work Saturdaythrough Tuesday (4 consecutive days)

The schedule rotates on a bi-weekly basis.

This rotation then repeats every two weeks, providing built-in extended breaks and predictability for work-life balance.

Holiday:You will be required to work the holiday if a holiday lands during your shift. Holiday pay includes your hours worked, plus 8 hours of holiday at your regular hourly rate.

Onboarding and Training Schedule:For the purposes of onboarding and training, the shift fir this position for the first 3 weeks will be Monday through Friday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Mountain.

Location requirements

Work from home in the United States

Why this job is exciting

This is a fast-paced, dynamic IT position. You will work hands-on with the latest technology in multiple client environments. All while engaging our clients in the process to understand their technology needs and enhance their technology efficiencies.

Who you are

You are a motivated and customer-focused Level II system administrator who supports our clients Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure. You have hands-on expertise in server/OS, networking, and storage systems, and will play a critical role in supporting multiple client’s environments.

You know how to:

  • Install, configure, and maintain servers, network devices, and storage systems following pre-defined process.

raw.description:
CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 9,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture.

A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You’ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down.

CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program.

Position Overview:
The Forensic Underwriter performs in-depth forensic underwriting reviews of closed mortgage loans for compliance with government agency and/or investor specific guidelines, and with applicable state and federal laws. This position conducts reviews to identify potential fraud and/or misrepresentation from any interested party to the transaction.The Forensic Underwriter is responsible for reviewing the loan file and coordinating the correction and tracking of any deficiencies identified.The review may include a formal written response to HUD, FNMA or investor to avoid potential buy-back requests.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Re-underwriting closed loan files to ensure that the loan meets agency or lender guidelines including but not limited to credit report review, income calculation, asset analysis and collateral assessment.

  • Review compliance documentation to verify adherence with any federal and state laws.

  • Analyze closing documentation such as mortgage note, CD, TRID to ensure properly executed, IPCs are not excessive, and fees are within federal/state tolerances.

  • Perform investigations to identify potential fraud through utilization of resources or re-verification of documents such as Lexis Nexis, written/verbal verifications, etc.

  • Attend regular meetings to discuss defects discovered from investor delivery or investors which are causing delays in purchase of loans from warehouse lines.

  • Collaborate with underwriting, sales processing, etc. to cure defects that are delaying loan from being purchased from warehouse line.

  • Prepare formal written responses to agencies/investors in which an audit has been performed and deficiencies discovered.

  • Perform accurate reporting of true deficiencies discovered for training and development opportunities.

  • Coordinate with the legal department regarding any potential fraud discovered to determine if SAR report should be filed.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Minimum 5 years’ underwriting experience with exposure to both manual and automated underwriting environments.

  • Knowledge of FNMA, FHLMC, FHA, VA, and USDA guidelines.

  • Knowledge of transaction components that indicate a potential for fraud.

  • Ellie Mae Encompass experience, preferred.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

However, this job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of qualifications, skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the position.

raw.description:
About Concept Plus

Concept Plus is a mission-focused technology solutions provider that transforms IT concepts into impactful solutions for federal agencies. Headquartered in Fairfax, VA, we bring the agility, responsiveness, and customer intimacy of a small business combined with the quality and infrastructure of a larger firm.

Recognized as an award-winning Oracle partner, we have delivered innovative solutions across Defense, Intelligence, Civilian, Health IT, and Tribal sectors. Our highly certified experts build systems that drive efficiency, accelerate modernization, and ensure mission outcomes with certainty.

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, paid life insurance, paid time off, 11 paid holidays, performance bonuses, tuition reimbursement, unlimited training, and the opportunity to thrive in a collaborative, flexible, and innovative environment.

For more information, visit .

About the role

Concept Plus LLC is seeking an Oracle OCI Cloud Engineer to provision, administer, and sustain Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments in support of an Oracle eBusiness, OCI hosted common services program. In this role, you will be responsible for the day-to-day administration, configuration, monitoring, and optimization of OCI resources including Compute, Networking, Storage, IAM, and related services within the Cloud One-provisioned OCI tenancy. You will work within an Integrated Team Structure alongside cloud architects, DevSecOps engineers, database administrators, and cybersecurity personnel to ensure the scalability, availability, and security of common services. This role requires 3 to 5 years of hands-on OCI administration experience and an active Oracle Cloud Infrastructure certification. An active Secret clearance and DoD 8140/8570 IAT-II or higher certification are required to start.

What you'll do

  • Provision, configure, and administer OCI resources including Compute instances, Virtual Cloud Networks (VCN), subnets, security lists, route tables, gateways, block and object storage, and Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies and compartments
  • Monitor OCI environment health, performance, and capacity utilization using OCI Monitoring, Logging, and Observability services; respond to alerts and resolve infrastructure issues in alignment with 24/7/365 operational support requirements
  • Support environment migrations to OCI, including lift-and-shift of existing workloads, resource rightsizing, and post-migration validation
  • Implement and maintain OCI security controls including compartment isolation, security zones, Cloud Guard, Vault-managed secrets, and network security group (NSG) policies in compliance with DoD RMF and Cloud One authorization requirements
  • Execute patching and maintenance activities for OCI-hosted infrastructure, including compute patching, OS-level updates, and OCI platform service upgrades, per approved change management procedures
  • Support backup, restore, and disaster recovery operations, including OCI Object Storage lifecycle policies, cross-region replication configurations, and DR/COOP failover testing
  • Collaborate with the DevSecOps Lead to implement and maintain IaC (Terraform) templates for repeatable, compliant OCI environment provisioning
  • Document OCI configurations, runbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to support operational continuity and knowledge transfer
  • Support the Technical Lead in implementing OCI architecture decisions, including the migration from legacy Oracle products to OCI-native equivalents (e.g., OCI GoldenGate Microservice, OCI IAM SSO Asserter, OCI Analytics Cloud)
  • Participate in Integrated Team ceremonies including sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives; contribute to backlog refinement for infrastructure-related work items
  • Assist the Cybersecurity Lead/ISSO with continuous monitoring, vulnerability scanning remediation, and ATO evidence collection for OCI-hosted resources
  • Support service management and onboarding processes, including provisioning new mission partner environments and managing access controls per DESMF-aligned procedures
  • Monitor and respond to OCI service quota limits, cost anomalies, and tenancy governance requirements in coordination with DISA and Cloud One administrators

Required Qualifications

  • US Citizen
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or related technical field; equivalent work experience considered
  • 3–5 years of hands-on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) administration experience, including Compute, Networking, Storage, IAM, and Monitoring
  • Active Oracle Cloud Infrastructure certification required at time of hire (e.g., OCI Foundations Associate, OCI Cloud Operations Professional, OCI Architect Associate, or equivalent)
  • Demonstrated experience provisioning and managing OCI tenancies, compartments, VCNs, and IAM policies
  • Experience with OCI security services including Cloud Guard, Security Zones, OCI Vault, and network security groups
  • Experience supporting backup/restore, capacity management, and patching activities in a cloud-hosted environment
  • Familiarity with DoD RMF, ATO processes, and cloud security compliance requirements
  • Active DoD Secret clearance required to start; must be maintainable for the duration of the program
  • Active DoD 8140/8570 IAT-II or higher certification required at time of hire (qualifying certifications include CompTIA Security+ CE, CompTIA CySA+, GSEC, SSCP, GICSP, CND, or any IAT-III equivalent such as CASP+ CE, CISSP, CISA, CCNP Security, GCED, or GCIH)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active Top Secret (TS) security clearance; candidates holding an active TS clearance will be given strong preference as the program's operational scope and data sensitivity may require TS access
  • Experience administering Linux (RHEL, Oracle Linux, or equivalent) server environments, including OS configuration, hardening, scripting, and performance tuning
  • Experience with Microsoft Windows Server administration, including Active Directory, Group Policy, and Windows-based workload management
  • Hands-on experience with container technologies including Docker and Kubernetes (K8s), including image management, container runtime administration, and cluster operations
  • Oracle Database Administration (DBA) experience, including database provisioning, patching, backup/recovery (RMAN), and performance monitoring on OCI or on-premises environments
  • Familiarity with Oracle Fusion Middleware components (WebLogic Server, Oracle SOA Suite, Oracle HTTP Server) and associated installation, configuration, and patching procedures · Experience implementing and managing DR/COOP architectures using Oracle GoldenGate (classic or Microservice) for near real-time data replication and Oracle Active Data Guard for standby database synchronization, failover, and switchover operations
  • Experience with OCI DevOps services, OCI Container Engine for Kubernetes (OKE), OCI Artifact Registry, or OCI Resource Manager (Terraform-as-a-service) · Experience operating within a DISA-managed or Cloud One cloud environment, including familiarity with IL4/IL5 authorization boundaries and tenancy governance processes
  • Familiarity with ITIL service management practices and DESMF-aligned operations procedures
  • Prior experience supporting AFLCMC, BES Directorate, or a DoD ERP program of record
  • Additional OCI certifications (e.g., OCI Architect Professional, OCI Security Professional, or OCI Database Professional) are a strong plus

Concept Plus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As such, we will give your application full consideration without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.
